cover.main: AN ISRAEL-BOUND FLYDUBAI PLANE REPORTEDLY DROPPED MIDAIR AFTER
cover.bottom: THEN LANDED SAFELY IN SAUDI ARABIA

photo.query: Flydubai Boeing 737 cockpit windows close up runway
photo.prompt: dramatic close-up of a Flydubai jet nose and cockpit windows on a runway at night with emergency lights in the distance

slides.headline: An Israel-bound Flydubai plane reportedly dropped midair after a cockpit stabbing
slides.body: The flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv landed safely in Saudi Arabia after passengers and crew overpowered the attacker.

photo.query: commercial airplane cockpit door cabin interior
photo.prompt: inside an airplane cabin looking toward a cockpit door with dim emergency-style lighting and no visible people

slides.headline: That came after one pilot allegedly stabbed another in the cockpit
slides.body: The injured pilot opened the cockpit door, which helped passengers and crew reach the attacker.

photo.prompt: Flydubai passenger jet parked at an airport gate at night with red and blue emergency lights reflecting on the tarmac

slides.headline: That also sent the plane down thousands of feet
slides.body: Passengers described a rapid descent during the cockpit struggle on the Dubai to Tel Aviv flight.
slides.source: ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos

photo.query: passenger airplane in steep descent dramatic sky
photo.prompt: passenger jet descending through dark clouds with a tense, dramatic sky and no airline logo visible

slides.headline: And Israel says passengers foiled an apparent crash attempt
slides.body: Israeli officials said passengers intervened after the cockpit stabbing and prevented a disaster.

photo.prompt: empty airplane cabin aisle with overhead lights on and a tense emergency atmosphere, no passengers visible

slides.headline: Which ended with a safe landing in Saudi Arabia
slides.body: The plane diverted to Saudi Arabia, where a Flydubai pilot was arrested and questioned.

photo.query: Saudi Arabia airport runway passenger jet night
photo.prompt: passenger jet on a Saudi airport runway at night with airport fire trucks parked nearby and flashing lights

slides.headline: So Netanyahu hailed the injured pilot as a hero
slides.body: Netanyahu said the pilot and passengers prevented a disaster, and the flight’s passengers later arrived in Israel.

photo.query: Benjamin Netanyahu press conference Israel airplane news
photo.prompt: dramatic news-style image of a podium and Israeli flags during an official statement, with a blurred aircraft image on a screen behind it
